The BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic now gets its location from a new helper, GetPropertyIdentifierLocation. The field MemberNeedsKey diagnostic now uses FirstOrDefault. When an analyzer callback is supplied, it is wrapped so that only diagnostics whose location is in a syntax tree of the current compilation get reported. Three tests build a defining assembly into a metadata image and check that the analyzer and generator raise no diagnostics and still produce the resolver.
